newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul exchange suspends trade in Dardanel.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul exchange suspends trade in Dardanel.

text.p: Istanbul Stock Exchange said it temporarily suspended trade in shares of canned and frozen food producer Dardanel Onentas Gida from Wednesday as a result of inspections to company books and facilities.

The Exchange board said in a statement it warned the firm to conform with capital markets and stock exchange laws and rules in informing the public about special developments regarding the firm's production and financial activities.

The exchange also asked Dardanel to provide monthly reports on the amount of borrowed and repaid loans, debt structure, loans extended to or borrowed from group firms and their interests, debts/receivables position with the group firms and Canakkale Dardanel sports club run by the group as well as its production, sales and inventories.
